text:
Sofia (Sales): Hey @Ravi — Acme wants a hosted-API POC. They estimate ~25M tokens over 3 months but will be very front-loaded. Ask: temporary per-token price $0.0009 (our standard is $0.0015) + min monthly commit $5k for the POC. Can Deal Desk approve a short-term tier/override they can sign this week?

Ravi (Deal Desk): Need a couple quick datapoints: legal entity name, who signs, whether billing will be invoice or card, and expected conversion to paid after POC (rough %). Also will this need any custom contract terms?

Sofia (Sales): Legal: Acme Dynamics Inc. Contract owner: their Head of AI (Maya Chen). Billing: invoice preferred. They said likely ~60% convert to paid with an expanded commit if POC goes well. No bespoke indemnities requested — standard enterprise SOW + our hosted terms.

Elena (Eng): From runtime side: we can support bursty traffic but want to limit sustained QPS. Suggest policy: allow 4x burst for first 14 days, then back to reserved throughput. Recommend prefix caching + client-side caching to reduce token spend for repeated prompts. Will need an API key whitelist for the POC.

Carlos (Security): Quick flags: they require SAML SSO for console access and ask about log retention. POC on hosted API is fine if we commit to 30-day logs and no custom data residency. They'll send a short sec questionnaire. Can't promise SIEM forwarding for POC unless through our partner integration.

Nate (Finance): Back-of-envelope on pricing: 25M tokens @ $0.0009 = $22,500 total; at standard $0.0015 would be $37,500. With a $5k/month min for 3 months floor = $15k. Estimated gross margin at 0.0009 is ~35% (depends on model/instance mix). Need RevOps/Legal sign-off for any temporary override and confirmation that this won't create precedent for other deals.

Ravi (Deal Desk): Proposed approval path: 1) Create a temporary rate-card entry "POC-Acme-3M" that applies only to Acme Dynamics account for 90 days; 2) Per-token = $0.0009, min monthly = $5,000, auto-revert to standard pricing after 90 days; 3) Quote must include that usage above 10M/month will trigger review and possible capacity reservation. If everyone OK I'll generate the quote and route to Legal.

quote-bot: Created quote POC-1763501234 for Acme Dynamics — https://redwood.example/quotes/POC-1763501234 (includes temporary rate card entry). :page_facing_up:

Sofia (Sales): I'll push the security questionnaire and a contract stub to Maya today. They prefer invoice billing net-30. Any objections to the proposed terms?

Elena (Eng): No objections from Eng. :+1: We just need the API key whitelist and the burst policy in the quote/ops ticket.

Carlos (Security): Approve in principle. Will review questionnaire answers; if they ask for logs >30d or custom retention we'll need to scope an addendum.

Nate (Finance): Approve pending RevOps confirmation that the quote flags this as a time-limited override and that margins are documented in the deal record.

Ravi (Deal Desk): Good — I'll attach the margin calc and special terms to the quote, then hand to Legal for fast review. Once Legal OK, Sales can sign.

Sofia (Sales): Great — moving this to legal and sending the questionnaire now. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Ravi (Deal Desk): FYI — logging a short internal precedent note: POC token overrides should require min 30-day commit or $5k floor and auto-expire. We'll revisit policy after this closes.

Sofia (Sales): Noted. I'll update the deal Slack thread with progress and the signed quote when done.

Carlos (Security): Ping me if the questionnaire reveals any elevated data handling requests.

Nate (Finance): I'll check the quote margin calc once it's attached.

Sofia (Sales): Closing thread — moving to legal.
